explanation: In C++, template specialization allows developers to define custom implementations of template classes or functions for specific types or conditions. This feature is essential for optimizing or customizing behavior when working with generic code, such as set operations on sorted containers. It enables writing flexible, type-safe code that adapts to particular data types or scenarios, improving efficiency and correctness in generic programming.
keywords: Template Specialization, Generic Set Operations, C++ Custom Templates, Set Operation Optimization
